text: Лампочка перегорела ровно тогда, когда стало темно, — и дядя Миша заметил это по её яркому свету.

Удар, оставивший на Фобосе кратер Стикни, скорее всего, едва не расколол эту луну.

Кратер больше девяти километров в поперечнике — почти половина диаметра всего Фобоса. Назвали его в честь Хлои Стикни Холл, математика и жены астронома Асафа Холла, который в 1877 году открыл обе луны Марса.

Сила тяжести там в тысячу с лишним раз слабее земной, но, судя по полосам на склонах, рыхлый грунт всё равно сползал вниз. Дядя Миша уверен: там даже лежачий камень рано или поздно поедет.

Пиздато: у Фобоса теперь есть кратер, которым можно хвастаться перед всеми лунами Марса.
Хуёво: откуда на Фобосе борозды, точно никто не знает: то ли приливы, то ли сам удар.

Мудрость дня: «Чем меньше притяжение, тем дольше грунт делает вид, что он на месте».

primary.text: Stickney Crater Explanation: Stickney Crater, the largest crater on the martian moon Phobos, is named for Chloe Angeline Stickney Hall, mathematician and wife of astronomer Asaph Hall. Asaph Hall discovered both the Red Planet's moons in 1877. Over 9 kilometers across, Stickney is nearly half the diameter of Phobos itself, so large that the impact that blasted out the crater likely came close to shattering the tiny moon. This enhanced-color image of Stickney and surroundings was recorded by the HiRISE camera onboard the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter as it passed within some six thousand kilometers of Phobos in March of 2008. Even though the surface gravity of asteroid-like Phobos is less than 1/1000th Earth's gravity, streaks suggest loose material slid down inside the crater walls over time. Light bluish regions near the crater's rim could indicate a relatively freshly exposed surface. The origin of the curious grooves along the surface is mysterious but may be related to tidal stresses experienced by close-orbiting Phobos or the crater-forming impact itself. text:
NASA ищет частные космические станции — вместе с доставкой людей туда и обратно

9 октября агентство объявило конкурс: американским компаниям предлагают спроектировать, построить и эксплуатировать станции на низкой орбите. NASA нужны места для исследований и подготовки экипажей после ухода МКС.

Заявки ждут до 8 декабря, контракты — весной 2027-го. На раннем этапе собираются выбрать как минимум двух подрядчиков, цена будет фиксированной.

Дядя Миша одобряет фиксированную цену: ремонт на орбите без «мы тут ещё кое-что нашли».

Пиздато: можно поручить стройку другим и заняться тем, ради чего всё затевалось.
Хуёво: подрядчику мало угодить NASA — придётся искать и других клиентов.

Мудрость дня: «Заказывая дом под ключ, уточни, как попадёшь к двери».

primary.text: NASA is advancing American leadership in space by taking the next step toward a future where commercial space stations lead the way in low Earth orbit. On Friday, the agency released its final Request for Proposals inviting industry to submit plans for the next generation of commercial space stations. “In alignment with the President’s National Space Policy, NASA is committed to maintaining a sustained American presence in low Earth orbit long after the International Space Station retires,” said NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman. “We will continue to need a place to conduct research, develop technologies, train crews, and prepare for missions to the Moon and Mars. Commercial space stations may provide that capability while creating new opportunities for American industry and allowing NASA to concentrate more of our resources on the near-impossible missions ahead.” Building on the agency’s Ignition event earlier this year, NASA regularly has engaged with private industry to shape the agency’s future direction in low Earth orbit. This included publishing two Requests for Information in March to gather industry’s perspective on low Earth orbit destinations and transportation. The agency also published a draft Request for Proposals in July, followed by an industry day and one-on-one meetings that allowed interested companies to review and comment on the planned acquisition approach. “We’ve made it clear that NASA will never give up its presence in low Earth orbit,” said Isaacman. “Since Ignition, we have spent a lot of time listening to industry and working through what it will take to make this transition successful. The opportunity is significant, but the economics ultimately have to work. We want to see credible plans, strong technical execution, and companies prepared to invest in destinations that can serve NASA while developing additional customers and markets of their own.” Proposals are due Tuesday, Dec. 8, with contract awards expected in spring 2027. Under the solicitation, NASA outlines requirements for companies interested in designing, building, testing, certifying, and operating commercial low Earth orbit destinations capable of providing end-to-end destination and transportation services for human spaceflight use. NASA intends to award firm-fixed-price, multi-award, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contracts supporting development, certification, and services for continued low Earth orbit research and exploration. This will allow NASA to select two or more contractors through early development, followed by a competitive task order for final design, test, and evaluation, as well as certification and services from one or more contractors.

primary.text: NASA is advancing American leadership in space by taking the next step toward a future where commercial space stations lead the way in low Earth orbit. On Friday, the agency released its final Request for Proposals inviting industry to submit plans for the next generation of commercial space stations. “In alignment with the President’s National Space Policy, NASA is committed to maintaining a sustained American presence in low Earth orbit long after the International Space Station retires,” said NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman. “We will continue to need a place to conduct research, develop technologies, train crews, and prepare for missions to the Moon and Mars. Commercial space stations may provide that capability while creating new opportunities for American industry and allowing NASA to concentrate more of our resources on the near-impossible missions ahead.” Building on the agency’s Ignition event earlier this year, NASA regularly has engaged with private industry to shape the agency’s future direction in low Earth orbit. This included publishing two Requests for Information in March to gather industry’s perspective on low Earth orbit destinations and transportation. The agency also published a draft Request for Proposals in July, followed by an industry day and one-on-one meetings that allowed interested companies to review and comment on the planned acquisition approach. “We’ve made it clear that NASA will never give up its presence in low Earth orbit,” said Isaacman. “Since Ignition, we have spent a lot of time listening to industry and working through what it will take to make this transition successful. The opportunity is significant, but the economics ultimately have to work. We want to see credible plans, strong technical execution, and companies prepared to invest in destinations that can serve NASA while developing additional customers and markets of their own.” Proposals are due Tuesday, Dec. 8, with contract awards expected in spring 2027. Under the solicitation, NASA outlines requirements for companies interested in designing, building, testing, certifying, and operating commercial low Earth orbit destinations capable of providing end-to-end destination and transportation services for human spaceflight use. NASA intends to award firm-fixed-price, multi-award, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contracts supporting development, certification, and services for continued low Earth orbit research and exploration. This will allow NASA to select two or more contractors through early development, followed by a competitive task order for final design, test, and evaluation, as well as certification and services from one or more contractors.

text:
Удар, оставивший на Фобосе кратер Стикни, скорее всего, едва не расколол эту луну.

Кратер больше девяти километров в поперечнике — почти половина диаметра всего Фобоса. Назвали его в честь Хлои Стикни Холл, математика и жены астронома Асафа Холла, который в 1877 году открыл обе луны Марса.

Сила тяжести там в тысячу с лишним раз слабее земной, но, судя по полосам на склонах, рыхлый грунт всё равно сползал вниз. Дядя Миша уверен: там даже лежачий камень рано или поздно поедет.

primary.text: Stickney Crater Explanation: Stickney Crater, the largest crater on the martian moon Phobos, is named for Chloe Angeline Stickney Hall, mathematician and wife of astronomer Asaph Hall. Asaph Hall discovered both the Red Planet's moons in 1877. Over 9 kilometers across, Stickney is nearly half the diameter of Phobos itself, so large that the impact that blasted out the crater likely came close to shattering the tiny moon. This enhanced-color image of Stickney and surroundings was recorded by the HiRISE camera onboard the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter as it passed within some six thousand kilometers of Phobos in March of 2008. Even though the surface gravity of asteroid-like Phobos is less than 1/1000th Earth's gravity, streaks suggest loose material slid down inside the crater walls over time. Light bluish regions near the crater's rim could indicate a relatively freshly exposed surface. The origin of the curious grooves along the surface is mysterious but may be related to tidal stresses experienced by close-orbiting Phobos or the crater-forming impact itself. history.text:
Дядя Миша листал пятничную ленту за кофе — а там 2000 банок энергетика и рекорд Гиннесса

Дядя Миша прибалдел: венгр Гергё Борбей получил рекорд Гиннесса за самую большую коллекцию банок энергетиков — 2000 штук.

Началось в 2008-м. Студент в Дебрецене искал что-нибудь холодное, взял первую в жизни банку энергетика и втянулся. Банки копились в общаге; он уже нёс их в переработку, но передумал и оставил по одной от каждой — штук пятнадцать. Дальше понеслось: банки из Японии, Румынии, со всей Европы.

В коллекции — банка Semtex 1994 года, японский Alien в стеклянной бутылке и восемь версий Michael Jackson Mystery из девяностых. Около 900 банок приклеены к наклонному потолку мансарды на липучки, остальные — на полках.

Пиздато: пятнадцать банок из общаги доросли до мирового рекорда.
Хуёво: чтобы всё уместить, пришлось оклеить потолок липучками.

Мудрость дня: «Никогда не выбрасывай мусор — вдруг через 18 лет это рекорд».

Мир ждёт твоего голоса: https://pizdato.net
